turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr Tan. I'm Dr Liew, the anesthesiologist who'll be taking care of you during your knee surgery today. Can I start by confirming a few details?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks. Let's start with your knee problem. How long have you been having issues with your left knee?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: About six months already, doc. Pain when I bend it or climb stairs. Tried physio and painkillers, but still got swelling and catching sensation inside.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Now, let's go through your medical history. I see in your records you're on montasone nasal spray and omeprazole. Can you confirm if you're still taking all these medications as listed?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Montasone spray, yes, one spray each nostril daily for my allergic rhinitis. But omeprazole? Oh, I stopped that in 2022 already. My GERD got better, so doctor said I can stop.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. So omeprazole was discontinued in 2022 after your GERD resolved?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, correct. No more heartburn since then, so no need for the pill anymore.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Any allergies we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: None that I know of, doctor. Never had reactions to medicines or food.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Have you eaten or drunk anything since midnight?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing since last night dinner. Just a bit of water with my montasone spray this morning.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Once, when I had my appendix out in 2015. Went smoothly, no problems waking up or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Finally, how's your overall fitness? Can you walk, climb stairs, do daily activities?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I can walk and climb stairs, but slowly because of the knee pain. Can't run or squat anymore, but otherwise okay lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Tan. We'll be using general anesthesia with sevoflurane and vecuronium, plus a nerve block in your thigh to help with post-op pain. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No questions, doctor. Just want to get this knee fixed so I can play badminton again.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. We'll take good care of you. I'll see you in the operating room shortly.
